sections.Profile:
"Amazon Hunt" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in September 1983. It has a jungle adventure theme with two flippers, no ramps, and no multiball. Designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Larry Day, it is part of the Gottlieb System 80A series and had a production run of 1,515 units.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1983–1987
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Original Theme, Solid State, Adventure, Archery, 1980s
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Larry Day
- Design: Ed Krynski
- Sound: Craig Beierwaltes
